title: Esgridge's POEMS work at Marshall and Alzofon's nucleonic spin

tellings.quote: something that Richard Esgridge looked into at Marshall and then uh Alzafon's nucleonic spin approaches that he sort of scrubbed with Fineman back in the 30s.

plain: A co-host named Jack says an engineer named Richard Esgridge studied an idea called POEMS at NASA's Marshall Space Flight Center, a rocket research center, and that a scientist named Alzofon worked on approaches based on nucleonic spin, the spin of the particles in an atom's core. Jack says Alzofon talked these ideas over with the famous physicist Richard Feynman back in the 1930s. He tells it without naming a source, as part of a talk about unusual ways of moving craft.
